snippet.title: Partial - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Uncover the truth behind the Partial project and the mystery of your own existence.

Partial is a difficult 2D action-adventure where you play as a vulnerable and bizarre creature, trying to survive.

Master difficult platforming, puzzles, and combat with limited retries exploring an unforgiving hazardous interconnected world.

Features:
Difficult 2D platforming
Dynamic action
Hostile environment
Exploration
Environmental puzzles
Interconnected world
Dynamic day/night cycle and changing weather according to its time calendar.

The controls of the game are pretty simple and available from the start, making their mastery very rewarding.

In Partial you are left to figure everything on your own. 

No markers, hand holding or yellow paint. Explore your environment, discover the solutions and unlock what is puzzling you to proceed.

Partial adopts clean orthographic visuals that blend stylized presentation with a small retro touch.

Partial features boss fights, unique enemies, challenging puzzles and dangerous hazards.

Are you up to the challenge?

Play the free Demo: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4952190/Partial
and get a taste of the difficult gameplay and aspects that define Partial.

Wishlist Now.
